note: Hand-derived oracle for hat-centre-start.plynal, from the recipe checks (rust/ply-nalbind/src/recipe/check.rs). The crown starts with 8 and increases 8 a round for 4 rounds (8 + 32 = 40); the slower increases go until the crown measures 17 cm across, which the recipe does not turn into a number, so every later count is unknown (one Info). The care note after the finish is not a step of the work.

segments.written: Start in the round at the centre with 8 stitches.
Increase 8 stitches in each round, working two stitches into the same loop of the previous round, for 4 rounds.
Increase 4 stitches in each round, working two stitches into the same loop of the previous round, until it measures 17 cm (across the crown).
Work in a spiral until it measures 14 cm (from the crown edge).
Work in a spiral for 4 rounds.
Finish at the open edge, tapering the last stitches to smooth the step.
Wash gently and dry flat over a bowl to shape the crown.

issues.text: Step 3 (Crown, slower): this step does not say how many stitches it adds in all, so the stitches after it cannot be counted; later counts are not checked
